verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents and ships an official MCP server (mcp.mem0.ai) that exposes memory tools to agents, with a live runtime probe confirming the hosted endpoint responds with proper MCP/OAuth handshake behavior, and docs describe pointing any client at it with a single command. This is corroborated by both docs and a hands-on runtime check, not just vendor claims. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) confirmation of successful end-to-end agent connection via the MCP server.
